research_question: After both BTCUSDT spot and USD-M futures form synchronized two-sided balances, does a cost-resolved futures-only external-liquidity sweep followed by a completed futures re-entry with opposite aggressive flow identify a durable rotation toward the opposite futures balance boundary?

economic_logic.liquidity_formation: The immediately preceding 30 synchronized UTC minutes must form two-sided balances in both spot and futures, evidenced by at least two completed-close crossings of each market's own frozen midpoint.
economic_logic.liquidity_collection: USD-M futures must trade at least one all-in per-side cost beyond its own frozen balance boundary while aggregate aggressive flow is aligned with the excursion.
economic_logic.cross_market_state: The primary requires that spot never completes the same cost-resolved excursion through its corresponding own frozen boundary before futures failure. No unconditional spot-leads or futures-leads assumption is made.
economic_logic.confirmation: Within the next three later completed synchronized minutes, futures must close back inside the frozen boundary with aggregate aggressive flow opposite the sweep direction.
economic_logic.expectation: A futures sweep rejected without corresponding spot confirmation represents a failed cross-market auction and is expected to rotate toward the opposite frozen futures boundary.
economic_logic.invalidation: The full observed futures sweep extreme plus one 7-bp all-in cost buffer.
economic_logic.destination: The opposite boundary of the frozen 30-minute futures balance.

pattern_scenario_separation.pattern_detector: detect_sweep_pattern freezes the prior joint balance and emits only a cost-resolved aligned-flow futures sweep observation.
pattern_scenario_separation.scenario_state_machine: CrossMarketFailedAuctionStateMachine tracks subsequent spot confirmation, futures extension, expiry and completed futures failure, then emits primary/control plans.
pattern_scenario_separation.execution: run_nautilus_tick_plan_backtest receives only completed plans and official futures TradeTicks; it exclusively owns orders, fills, fees, margin, positions, PnL and NAV.

data_contract.source: Official Binance Vision daily BTCUSDT spot and USD-M futures aggTrades archives
data_contract.integrity: Every ZIP must match its published SHA-256 CHECKSUM before parsing.
data_contract.timestamp_normalization: Milliseconds and post-2025 spot microseconds are normalized to nanoseconds by magnitude.
data_contract.bar_clock: Exact UTC one-minute boundaries; a bar is available only at minute end, never at its last trade timestamp.
data_contract.synchronization: Only minutes containing official trades in both markets are joined; the weekly gate requires zero missing or unmatched BTC minutes.
data_contract.execution_stream: Official USD-M aggregate trades are represented one-for-one as NautilusTrader TradeTicks.

frozen_parameters.minimum_structure_width_basis: Four times 7 bps, equal to two frozen round trips; not PnL fitted.
frozen_parameters.minimum_sweep_basis: One frozen all-in per-side cost; not PnL fitted.
frozen_parameters.confirmation_window_basis: Immediate failed-auction response horizon fixed before performance evaluation; no week-specific tuning.

primary.variable: No cost-resolved spot excursion through the corresponding frozen spot boundary before completed futures failure.

week_selection.pool: Every UTC Monday from 2020-01-06 through 2025-12-29 inclusive with official BTCUSDT spot and USD-M archive eligibility.
week_selection.algorithm: For every eligible Monday compute SHA256(seed + '|' + ISO-date), sort lexicographically by full digest, and take the first three.
week_selection.staging: Run week 1 only. Week 2 opens only after the primary weekly gate and primary/control discrimination comparison advance. Week 3 opens only after the unchanged week-2 gate and discrimination comparison advance.

operational: all checksum and exact-minute causality assertions
weekly_gate.ablation_discrimination_required: Primary must exclude at least one control event and strictly improve win rate, total return, geometric daily return, profit factor and maximum drawdown, with at least seven primary trades.

long_evaluation_policy: Closed until all three frozen BTC weeks advance unchanged. ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT and XRPUSDT remain closed until BTC demonstrates repeatable post-cost alpha.

research_basis.supported_point: Spot and futures aggTrades schemas, daily archives, post-2025 spot microsecond timestamps and per-file checksums.

research_basis.source: Kapar and Olmo, An analysis of price discovery between Bitcoin futures and spot markets, Economics Letters 174 (2019)
research_basis.supported_point: One sample finds futures dominant in Bitcoin price discovery.

research_basis.source: Baur and Dimpfl, Price discovery in Bitcoin spot or futures?, Journal of Futures Markets (2019)
research_basis.supported_point: Another intraday sample finds spot price discovery, so leadership is not frozen unconditionally.

research_basis.source: Cont, Kukanov and Stoikov, The Price Impact of Order Book Events, Journal of Financial Econometrics (2014)
research_basis.supported_point: Order-flow imbalance and liquidity state motivate requiring opposite aggressive flow rather than treating a wick alone as a failed auction.

prohibited_adaptations_after_week_1: Changing any threshold, balance length, confirmation horizon, stop, target, hold, risk or cost because of week-1 PnL
Adding session, volatility, direction or score filters to rescue the candidate
Running a long period after a failed first-week gate
Treating spot or futures as the permanent price-discovery leader
